releaseNotes: Repairs Text mode so tapping an empty point on the note page creates and focuses a positioned text block
Keeps handwriting and marker ink above typed text in Pen and Marker modes
Replaces browser confirmation dialogs with LuMa Slate in-app confirmation dialogs for Ink löschen and Notiz löschen
Ink löschen clears only handwriting and marker strokes on the current page after confirmation
Notiz löschen removes the complete note only after explicit confirmation
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
